object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Create an object, undo the create, create again. Create, undo, redo and undo again. Make a step with an edit and a create and a later step with a create, then undo the later and then the earlier. Create two objects, undo both, newest first, and create a third. Expected: after each undo or redo the next object number is no lower than before it; no new object gets an undone object's ID.
